system.bio:
Original STTH game by McShmoodle. Terminal Velocity Pawn: a homebrew combat adaptation of the silver-and-purple armored background Egg Pawns stationed at the space elevator in Sonic Colors / Ultimate. Their placement and spear equipment inspire this sentry profile; no canonical combat moveset or late-game combat difficulty is claimed.

Role: armored corridor sentry, not a speed-chasing robot or boss. Holds elevator approaches and narrow walkways with a removable reach spear. Use Block (Power 4) against one declared incoming hit; equipped plating provides DR 2 afterward, per the system's custom defense rules. Choose Block, Dodge, or Parry once per hit. These are alternatives, not extra defenses. Plating DR does not stack with other armor DR.

Tactics: defend a choke point, make one normal spear attack per Action, and fall back if disarmed. A separate adjacent fist attack remains available without the spear. No free opportunity attack, automatic interception, forced fall, invulnerability, multiple turns, or resistance to the stage's black hole. Environmental hazards follow scene rules.

Canon reference: Sonic Wiki Zone, Egg Pawn and Terminal Velocity pages describe these armored spear-bearing Pawns as background appearances. All statistics, armor DR and sentry tactics here are community homebrew and untested.
